headline: Typhoon Obet Exits PAR as Habagat Rains Persist Over Western Luzon
seoTitle: Typhoon Obet Exits PAR; Habagat Rains Persist | FMB News
seoDescription: Typhoon Obet exited PAR before dawn on August 25 while PAGASA warned that Habagat rains would continue over parts of western Luzon.
deck: The typhoon cleared the Philippine monitoring boundary before dawn, but the southwest monsoon remained the main rainmaker over western Luzon.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Typhoon Obet, internationally known as Saudel, exited the Philippine Area of Responsibility before dawn Tuesday, August 25, according to the approved FMB News weather brief citing PAGASA.
The storm remained offshore, while the southwest monsoon continued to bring rain to parts of western Luzon.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The newsroom brief placed Obet outside PAR early Tuesday and said monsoon conditions remained relevant for Pangasinan, Zambales, Bataan and nearby western areas. Forecast details can change quickly and residents should continue following current PAGASA and local disaster advisories.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A cyclone leaving PAR does not automatically end weather hazards. Enhanced monsoon flow can continue producing rain, rough seas and localized flooding after the storm center has moved away.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch PAGASA rainfall and marine advisories and local government notices for areas with saturated ground, swollen waterways or continuing class and transport disruptions.
